title: feat(k4v30dyn): k=4 map (1,1,1,0,0) 1-site history disagrees with L1
science: Single-map history run in the k=4 sub-series: the F_cut map (1,1,1,0,0) has k=4 (fills all four long-axis 2-site seeds) but cov=36, so it is a long-axis filler that is NOT a two-site coverage maximizer. From the 1-site seed it fills at T=5 with history (1,4,8,10,11,12), which does NOT match f_L1's (1,4,8,11,12) - the extra tick is the vertex3=0 delay. Modest: one map, one seed, and the k=4/cov facts are stated more completely in #6446.
